{{Top|leg}}
An '''Outside Threat Indicator Array''', abbreviated '''OTIA''', was a component used in some [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters']] [[Heads-up display/Legends|heads-up displays]]. It provided [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] with warnings about [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and [[Missile/Legends|missiles]] targeting the starfighter.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|429|OTIA}}</ref>
